sobre.quemSomosTexto1: Here at SAL you will experience a complete gastronomic experience in a warm environment, with a team ready to serve you.
sobre.quemSomosTexto2: SAL's kitchen is marked by bold seasoning and quality ingredients, a strong characteristic of Chef Henrique Fogaça, which is not being afraid to make mistakes and take risks in his creations.

sobre.inauguracaoDesc: O Sal Gastronomia is founded in the Higienópolis neighborhood, São Paulo, bringing a new proposal of contemporary Brazilian cuisine.
sobre.segundaUnidadeDesc: Opening of the second restaurant at Shopping Cidade Jardim, in the Morumbi neighborhood, with a stunning setting and city views.
sobre.renovacaoDesc: The Higienópolis location closes its doors in December, while the Shopping Cidade Jardim unit continues strong, now complemented by the new Bela Cintra location in Jardins.
sobre.presenteDesc: Two locations operating in São Paulo, continuing the tradition of offering unique and unforgettable gastronomic experiences.
sobre.qualidadeDesc: Selected ingredients and precise seasoning in every dish that leaves our kitchen.
sobre.ousadiaDesc: We are not afraid to make mistakes and take risks in our creations, always seeking to surprise.
sobre.acolhimentoDesc: A warm environment and a team ready to provide the best experience.

chefs.fogacaRole: Chef in Charge of the Menu
fogacaBio: Henrique Fogaça is the Chef in charge of the menu at O Sal Gastronomia. Cook, father of Olívia, João, and Maria Letícia.
A Brazilian chef and restaurateur born in Piracicaba, in the interior of São Paulo. He is also part of the judging panel of the show "MasterChef Brasil", aired by Band, which premiered in 2014.
At the beginning of his career, Henrique would buy ingredients at Ceasa and spend hours mixing, experimenting, and testing his discoveries.

He started with a small food truck and after years of study, customer feedback, always believing that nothing is impossible and overcoming the difficulties of entrepreneurship, the Chef opened his first restaurant with signature dishes, prepared with quality ingredients and great taste.

Today, the Band reality show judge Henrique Fogaça divides his life between the kitchens of O Sal Gastronomia, Sal Grosso, Cão Véio, the rock band Oitão where he is the vocalist, and his family, which is his foundation and what makes him want to be better every day.
douglasBio: His interest in gastronomy began in childhood, helping his parents in their family food business. As an amateur, the desire to learn more and gain knowledge about gastronomy grew.
He pursued technical courses and college, and during that time the opportunity arose to join the Sal Gastronomia restaurant as an intern, where he already knew Henrique Fogaça from his rock shows.

He started his internship, and in a short time, with a lot of hard work, he became Sub Chef. He left the restaurant and shortly after returned at the invitation of Chef Henrique, doing events inside and outside the restaurant and in several states, including outside of Brazil.
His return brought the opportunity to lead the Sal Gastronomia Higienópolis location, the first SAL unit.
In this back-and-forth journey, 10 years have already passed alongside Chef Henrique Fogaça, helping to maintain the standard and prestige, further increasing the success of O Sal Gastronomia.
chefs.equipeTexto: Under the leadership of Chefs Henrique Fogaça and Douglas Chavez, the O Sal Gastronomia team works with passion and dedication to deliver an unforgettable gastronomic experience.
